structured_output.rationale: 271 for DOS 2026-01-05 returns EB*R for Novitas Medicare Part B FFS with MSG "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER." Claim was filed SBR*P (primary) to Keystone CI. OA-22 confirms wrong COB order; MA04 on MOA is a downstream symptom — no primary adjudication data exists because Medicare was never billed. Bill Medicare first, then Keystone as secondary.

root_cause.explanation: 271 shows EB*R Novitas Medicare Part B FFS as primary for DOS 20260105. Claim billed SBR*P to Keystone (CI). OA-22 on all three lines confirms wrong payer order; MA04 is a symptom — no primary adjudication data on record.

next_action.detail: Submit new original claim (CLM05-3=1) to Novitas Medicare Part B (NPI/ID 1846349352). After Medicare adjudicates, rebill Keystone as secondary with Medicare's payment/adjustment data in SBR/CAS/AMT loops. Do not appeal Keystone.

evidence.fact: EB*R loop names NOVITAS SOLUTIONS MEDICARE PART B FFS with DTP*356*D8*20240101 and MSG 'PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER' for DOS 20260105
evidence.locator: EB*R segment, NM1*PR loop, MSG segment

evidence.fact: SBR*P*18*******CI — claim filed as primary responsibility to Keystone Commercial Health
All three lines carry CAS*OA*22; MOA MA04 at claim level; $0 paid on CLP status 4

citations.rule: CARC 22 alone → resubmit_other_payer; EB*R proves another payer is on record; never appeal a disclaiming payer
MA04 is a completeness defect (primary adjudication data missing); here it is downstream of wrong routing, not an independent defect on a correctly-ordered claim
